capability.detail: no MCP server is registered; register one (POST /mcp/servers) to give KAI MCP tools

note: MCP servers are KAI-owned capabilities. Every MCP tool is registered into KAI's one tool registry (validate -> policy -> (approval) -> execute); every invocation is recorded in the MCP provenance ledger. A management call that parks answers 409 with an approvalId; retry the same request with it once a human decides.
